apps.name: Microsoft Word
apps.defaultFont: Calibri, size 11pt (previously Times New Roman 12pt in Word 2003)

ribbonTabs.items: Clipboard, Font, Paragraph (alignments, bullets, line spacing), Styles, Editing (Find, Replace).
Pages (Cover Page, Blank, Page Break), Tables, Illustrations (Pictures, Shapes, SmartArt, Charts), Header & Footer, Page Number, WordArt, Equation, Symbol.
Themes, Margins (Normal, Narrow, Wide), Orientation (Portrait, Landscape), Size (A4, Letter), Columns, Breaks, Watermark, Page Color, Page Borders.
Table of Contents, Footnotes / Endnotes, Citations & Bibliography, Captions, Index, Table of Authorities.
Envelopes, Labels, Start Mail Merge (Letters, E-mail, Envelopes, Labels, Directory), Select Recipients, Insert Merge Field, Finish & Merge.
Spelling & Grammar (F7), Thesaurus (Shift+F7), Word Count, Translate, Comments, Tracking (Track Changes), Compare, Protect.
Views (Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, Draft), Ruler, Gridlines, Navigation Pane, Zoom (10% min to 500% max), Macros (Alt+F8).

keyFeatures.name: Mail Merge
keyFeatures.desc: Combines a Main Document (letter, envelope) with a Data Source (Excel sheet, Access table, Outlook contacts) to generate personalized mass documents.

keyFeatures.name: Header & Footer
keyFeatures.desc: Content repeated at top (header) and bottom (footer) of every page. Header resides inside the top margin.

keyFeatures.name: Footnote vs Endnote
keyFeatures.desc: Footnote appears at the bottom of the current page. Endnote appears at the very end of the document (or section).

keyFeatures.name: Drop Cap
keyFeatures.desc: Decorative large initial letter of a paragraph spanning 3 lines by default (max 10 lines).

keyFeatures.name: Watermark
keyFeatures.desc: Faded background text or image behind the text on all pages (e.g. 'CONFIDENTIAL', 'DO NOT COPY').

examTips: Difference between Footnote and Endnote: Footnote is placed at bottom of each page; Endnote is placed at the end of entire document.
Default extension in modern Word is .docx (XML-based, compressed zip container).
Max Zoom in MS Word is 500% (whereas in Excel and PowerPoint it is 400%).

apps.name: Microsoft Excel

structure.rows: 1,048,576 rows per worksheet (numbered 1 to 1048576; previously 65,536 in Excel 2003)
structure.columns: 16,384 columns per worksheet (lettered A to XFD; previously 256 / IV in Excel 2003)
structure.cellAddress: Intersection of column letter and row number (e.g., A1, B12, XFD1048576)
structure.nameBox: Displays the address of currently active cell or named range (located left of formula bar)
structure.formulaBar: Displays the formula or data contained in the active cell. All formulas begin with '=' sign.

cellReferencing.desc: Changes dynamically when copied to other cells relative to row/column movement.
Anchors both column and row using '$' symbol. Never changes when copied. Press F4 to toggle.
Locks either the column ($A1) or the row (A$1), leaving the other free to change.

essentialFormulas.name: SUM
essentialFormulas.desc: Calculates total arithmetic sum of numeric values in range.

essentialFormulas.name: AVERAGE
essentialFormulas.desc: Calculates arithmetic mean of numeric cells in range.

essentialFormulas.name: MAX / MIN
essentialFormulas.desc: Finds largest or smallest numeric value in range.

essentialFormulas.name: COUNT
essentialFormulas.desc: Counts only cells that contain numbers.

essentialFormulas.name: COUNTA
essentialFormulas.desc: Counts all non-empty cells (numbers, text, logical values, errors).

essentialFormulas.name: COUNTBLANK
essentialFormulas.desc: Counts empty cells in the specified range.

essentialFormulas.name: IF
essentialFormulas.desc: Logical test condition and returns corresponding value.

essentialFormulas.name: VLOOKUP
essentialFormulas.desc: Vertical lookup: searches first column of table for lookup value and returns corresponding column item.

essentialFormulas.name: HLOOKUP
essentialFormulas.desc: Horizontal lookup: searches top row and returns item from specified row.

commonErrors.cause: Column width is too narrow to display the number, or negative date/time.
Formula attempts to divide by zero or an empty cell.
'No value available' - lookup formula fails to find matching record.
Excel does not recognize text in formula (misspelled function name like =SUMM).
Incorrect intersection operator specified (e.g. space between two non-intersecting ranges).
Formula contains invalid numeric values (e.g. square root of negative number).
Invalid cell reference (cell was deleted or pasted over).
Wrong type of argument (e.g. mathematical operation on a text string like =A1+'text').

examTips: How many columns and rows in Excel 2016/2019/365? 16,384 columns (A to XFD) and 1,048,576 rows.
In Excel, text data is left-aligned by default, while numbers and dates are right-aligned by default.
To start a formula, which symbol is mandatory? '=' (Equals sign).

apps.name: Microsoft PowerPoint
apps.defaultExt: .pptx (standard), .ppsx (PowerPoint Show - opens directly in slideshow mode), .potx (template)

views.name: Normal View
views.desc: Primary editing view with slide thumbnail pane on left and large active slide workspace in center.

views.name: Slide Sorter View
views.desc: Shows thumbnail grid of all slides; best for reorganizing, reordering, and deleting slides.

views.name: Notes Page View
views.desc: Displays slide with speaker notes beneath it for lecture preparation.

views.name: Slide Show View
views.desc: Full-screen presentation view (F5 from beginning, Shift+F5 from current slide).

views.name: Slide Master View
views.desc: Hierarchy of slides that stores information about the theme, layout, background, fonts, and colors for the entire presentation.

transitionsVsAnimations.transition: Motion effect that occurs when you move from one slide to the next during a presentation.
transitionsVsAnimations.animation: Visual or sound effect applied to individual elements (text, picture, chart, shape) on a single slide.

slideShowShortcuts.action: Turn screen black / return to show.
Turn screen white / return to show.
Change mouse pointer to Pen tool during show.
Switch pointer to Eraser tool during show.

examTips: Shortcut to insert a NEW SLIDE is Ctrl + M (NOT Ctrl+N, which opens a new presentation file). Extremely common trap!
Shortcut to duplicate current slide is Ctrl + D.
